releaseRangeMult = input(1.5, "Release Range Mult", 1.0, 4.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trA = max(tr1, tr2)
tr = max(trA, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rngPrev = rng[1]
atrPrev = atrVal[1]

coilMax = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilMin = lowest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilSpan = coilMax - coilMin + 0.000001
loadRaw = 1 - (atrVal - coilMin) / coilSpan
load = loadRaw * (close * 0 + 1)

rngMax = highest(rng, coilLen)
rangeRatio = rng / (rngMax + 0.000001)

vovMax = highest(atrVal, vovLen)
vovMin = lowest(atrVal, vovLen)

pastClose = close[coilLen]

totMove = sma(rng, coilLen) * coilLen

rngExp = rng > rngPrev * releaseRangeMult

var bh4 = 0.0

    bl4 := bl3
    bl3 := bl2

    bl0 := htfLow
}

swingHighNow = bh1 > bh2 and bh1 > bh0 and bh1 != 0
swingLowNow = bl1 < bl2 and bl1 < bl0 and bl1 != 0

if swingHighNow {
    lastSH2 := lastSH1
    lastSH1 := bh1
}
if swingLowNow {

    lastSL1 := bl1
}

bullStruct = lastSH1 > lastSH2 and lastSL1 > lastSL2 and lastSH1 != 0 and lastSH2 != 0 and lastSL1 != 0 and lastSL2 != 0
bearStruct = lastSH1 < lastSH2 and lastSL1 < lastSL2 and lastSH1 != 0 and lastSH2 != 0 and lastSL1 != 0 and lastSL2 != 0

bosUp = lastSH1 > lastSH2
bosDown = lastSH1 < lastSH2

breakUp = close > sessHigh[1] and close[1] <= sessHigh[1]
breakDown = close < sessLow[1] and close[1] >= sessLow[1]

longConf = (bullStruct ? 50 : 0) + (bosUp ? 25 : 0) + (breakUp ? 25 : 0)

longStopPrice = sessLow - offset

inLong = posDir[1] == 1

sellSig = breakDown and bearStruct and shortConf >= confThresh and allowShort and confirmClose and not inShort
